name: chocolate cranberry museli
ingredients: 58% Whole Grain (Rolled Oats, Brown Rice Flakes, Quinoa Flakes). 14% Seeds & Nuts (Pumpkin. Almonds, Chia, Flax), 11% Dried Fruits (Cranberry. Raisins). Dark Chocolate (Cocoa. Cocoa-Butter, Sugar. Soy Lecithin), Date Syrup. Jaggery. Rice Bran Oil, Cocoa Powder, Apple Fiber, Himalayan Pink Salt. CONTAINS ADDED NATURAL FLAVOURS: CHOCOLATE, ROSEMARY EXTRACT.
